route_note: The plan default route kimi-code-plan-cn/kimi-for-coding#high is in WAIT (weekly 98 %, reset 18:46 ICT), so the orchestrator chose opencode-go/deepseek-v4.1-flash. DeepSeek is not the Anthropic family, so decision P14-D14 and rule L15 hold for this role.

paraphrase.proposes: Phase 14 separates initial-sound recognition from final-sound and middle-sound recognition in the Level 2 Storytime weeks. The phase adds the field `focus.paStage` to w01 to w08, the pure module `sound-stages.ts` with the stage plan, and three check rows that fail a week which mixes two sound positions or opens day 1 with a new sound. It changes 114 field rows and 10 media files by the change list, and it rebuilds the teacher book as TH-v3 and the student book as v18. Day 1 of w01 becomes an echo warm-up with no sound question.
paraphrase.current_system: Per the spec, the day-1 and day-2 openings of w01 to w07 ask two sound positions of the new sound in one line. Step A1 of w02 to w07 holds three last-sound or middle-sound words, with a teacher line that says Now listen to the end or Now listen to the middle. The tags carry `english.phonics.pa.final-sound.identify` and `english.phonics.pa.medial-vowel.identify`, and `focus.paSkill` names both positions. `FocusSchema` is not strict, so a parse drops an unknown key, and the Monorepo `focusSchema` is `passthrough`, so the app ignores a new field. The check pages, the home cards, and the print blocks ask the first sound only, and the w08 Benchmark 1 page is the only student-book page with a last-sound task.

zoom_out: The phase solves the root fault that Daniel named, a skill order fault in the content, and not a symptom: the stage plan goes into the week data, three check rows read the rule from the data, and the unit 2 drafts get the same rule through the plan. The phase adds no speculative feature and no premature optimization. Each reuse claim cites a file and a symbol: `manual.ts:291` prints the day line, `phonemes.ts:98` builds the audio list, `word-clips.ts:447` gives the word keys, `check-weeks.ts:205` checks the clip of each opening word, and the new rows join that CLI. The logic sits in a new pure module plus three rows, which is the place the existing checks live. The content change is text only, and the phase stays at the requirement level through the change list.
nonblocking_findings: F1 [Major] spec.md:1105 to 1109 (row R14-2, the rule and the detail parts): the new-sound part compares each label with `focus.element.sound`, and w08 has no `focus.element` key (its focus keys are family, frame, paSkill, trickyWords, and wordWall). The text does not say what the row does when the week has no focus sound, and S8 requires `pass` for w08. Fix: add one sentence to R14-2, in the form when the week has no `focus.element.sound` the new-sound part gives no part, and repeat it in S5 and S8. Rationale: Red must otherwise choose between a guard and a throw for the one shipped week that hits this case, and an edge-case behavior is a design choice that the plan must pin.

F2 [Nit] spec.md:1032 (Facts, the tests that pin a value): the text puts the table `OPENING_KEYS` at line 125 of `storytime-package-practice-clips.test.ts`, and the table starts at line 124. The counts array line 1496 and the a48 line 339 are exact, and the other two anchors (PICTURE_CARDS at 87 and SOUND_PICTURE_CARDS at 94) are exact. Fix: change 125 to 124. Rationale: the symbol name is given, so Red makes no choice; a wrong line only wastes a read.
